relay.brief: Imperial Sith troopers are closing on a frontier hyperspace relay. Hold it for 8 turns until the fleet arrives. Three waves are expected.

shrine.brief: Sith troopers are raiding a kyber shrine. Pilgrims swear something else came with them: a beast that hunts Jedi. Hold for 6 turns.

rescue.brief: Sith raiders hold a prisoner in a locked cell. A Medic can Hack the door from 4 tiles; a Jedi can try the console. Then walk the prisoner to an evac zone (E).

envoy.brief: A Republic envoy is leaking the peace-talk schedule. Scan his data terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent). Once 2 are copied, anyone who reaches an evac zone gets the data out. Capture him if you can.

archive.brief: An Imperial post is reading Republic fleet traffic. Copy its data terminals (Jedi or Medic, adjacent), then get anyone to an evac zone. Blast walls crack under explosions.

sabotage.brief: The Empire fuels its Balmorra fleet from this depot. Plant charges on 2 sites (anyone, adjacent, 1 action), then get every standing squad member onto the far evac zone. The charges blow when you are clear.

escort.brief: Someone the Empire wants dead must reach a shuttle at the far evac zone. They take one move a turn on your phase. Keep them alive.
